children: Bally's appointed George Papanier to once again act as its interim chief financial officer, effective Sept. 4.

He will succeed Mira Mircheva, who plans to resign from her positions as executive vice president and CFO on the same day. Mircheva is leaving for personal reasons, the company said Thursday, and she will remain with Bally's through Sept. 30 to help with the transition.
Papanier will retain his current position as president of the company and his seat on the board of directors, which has already initiated a search to find a permanent CFO.
President of Bally's land-based casino operations since October 2021, Papanier was previously president and CEO of the gaming company from February 2011 to October 2021.
Papnier was interim CFO in 2023, and joined Bally's in 2004 as chief operating officer.
